notes: Packet vitamin-d3-evidence-expansion-001 remains review-gated. Whole-claim reviewer results: one confirm, two request-changes, four unresolved. This packet-scoped request-changes decision does not declare every claim false.

Correct PCT source design and attribution: the Frontiers study tested seized products; its adverse-event percentages cite prior literature, not its own patient survey. Distinguish product and patient denominators and accurately describe the two discordant tamoxifen samples.

Complete independent-family coverage, current product-label verification, and unresolved identifiers. Preserve existing authority flags and conflicts; the prior ATLAS efficacy classification is not permission to bypass embedded safety-assertion review.
